resale_co.notes: The Borough website (hibu site) has no resale, certificate of occupancy, or code enforcement pages or forms. The phone directory lists construction as handled by NJ DCA at (609) 567-3653, and the Borough calendar shows weekly 'Construction Official Hours'. The Borough code is not on the website and ecode360 could not be checked. Silence is not proof there is no resale CO requirement; call the Borough Clerk (856-784-6237 ext. 400) to confirm.

requirements: All smoke alarms (hardwired and battery) must be less than 10 years old; take them down and check the date, replace if undated
Smoke alarm type by build year: pre-1975 homes need 10-year sealed battery alarms on each level; newer homes need hardwired, interconnected alarms per the year-built chart
Smoke alarm in each sleeping area plus one outside each sleeping area within 10 feet (local ordinance 172-8 B)
CO alarm outside of and near all sleeping areas if there is a fuel-burning appliance, fireplace or garage; CO alarms must be less than 7 years old
Low-voltage alarm systems must be tested by an alarm contractor before the inspection, with the certificate shown to the inspector
House numbers: Arabic numerals at least 3 inches, contrasting, at least 60 inches above ground, visible from the street
Homes with a secondary power source (solar, generator, battery storage) need a printed label within 18 inches of the main panel and meter, like "CAUTION MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER"

Fire extinguisher (June 2025 form): fully charged 2-A:10-BC in or within 10 feet of the kitchen, visible, mounted no higher than 5 feet, and either under 1 year old or tagged by a NJ certified fire equipment contractor

authorities.name: Regional Fire Prevention Alliance (Borough of Barrington Bureau of Fire Prevention)
authorities.area_served: Serves Barrington, Hi-Nella, Lawnside, Mt. Ephraim and Oaklyn; covers the entire borough
authorities.lead_time: Lowest fee with 14 or more business days notice before the change of occupant (weekends, holidays and the settlement date do not count)

fees.label: Request received 14+ business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: 14+ business days prior to the change of occupant is $66.00.

fees.label: Request received 8 to 13 business days before
fees.quote: 8-13 business days prior to the change of occupant is $74.00.

fees.label: Request received 4 to 7 business days before
fees.quote: 4-7 business days prior to the change of occupant is $106.00.

fees.label: 3 business days or less notice
fees.quote: 3 business days or less notice prior to change of occupant is $171.00.

fees.label: Re-inspection after a failed inspection
fees.quote: ALL FAILED INSPECTIONS WILL REQUIRED A $50.00 RE INSPECTION FEE.

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Alliance's certificate application and email it to firealliance@barringtonboro.com, or print it and drop it in the mailbox or mail it to 205 Haines Avenue, Barrington, NJ 08007. A check or money order payable to 'Regional Fire Prevention Alliance' must go with the application. Fees are non-refundable.

fire_cert.notes: Two versions of the Alliance form were found with the same fees. The Barrington-hosted November 2025 version is titled a Smoke Alarm, CO Alarm and Secondary Power Source Identification Label (CSACMASPSIL) application and omits the extinguisher section; it states a $500 penalty. The June 2025 version hosted by Lawnside is titled CSACMAPFEC, includes the extinguisher rules, and states a $600 penalty. Walk-in office hours Tuesday to Friday 8am to 2pm; inspections Monday to Friday 9am to 2pm. Fire Official Nick D'Alonzo, fireofficial@barringtonboro.com. DCA fire directory lists Fire Official Nicholas D'Alonzo for this borough.
